stories.title: Tight QB1 races for the Falcons, Browns, Raiders and Vikings? We projected the Week 1 starters
stories.summary: Tua Tagovailoa or Michael Penix Jr.? Deshaun Watson or Shedeur Sanders? We talked to NFL sources to project open QB1 races in Cleveland, Las Vegas, Atlanta and Minnesota.

stories.title: Sources: Probe into Clips, Kawhi could go into '27
stories.summary: The NBA investigation into whether the Clippers circumvented the salary cap to pay Kawhi Leonard could drag into 2027 if the parties don't agree on the findings or any proposed settlement that involves punishing the team, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Allen backs Bills' panned new unis: 'Stop hating'
stories.summary: Josh Allen defended the Bills' widely panned alternate uniforms, saying the franchise has to "move forward and do something new."

stories.title: 49ers have 'concern' over Pearsall's knee flare up
stories.summary: 49ers WR Ricky Pearsall did not participate in practice Wednesday because of swelling in the PCL in his right knee. The Niners say they have some "concern" about the latest flare up and are "exploring all options."

stories.title: Bengals' Stewart carted off with left leg injury
stories.summary: Bengals defensive end Shemar Stewart was carted off the field Wednesday with a left leg injury suffered during the first day of training camp.
